notes.title: Upcoming updates and new game
notes.notes:
Hey there, it's SHAWAVERSE!
A year has passed since the release of the first episodes on Steam. During this time we have received a lot of feedback and suggestions for improvement. Thank you for your activity and support! <3

If you haven't left a review yet, now is the time to do so! Reviews energize us and motivate to create awesome content for you!

We've released a new game about sad anime girls and shawarma!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186690/BRXKEN_INSIDE/

[h2]Upcoming updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] New bonus episode
[*] Update the synopsis to better show what our visual novel is about
[*] Update the early access description
[*] Add an English translation for the episode "VademeCUM"
[/list]

[h2]List of episodes[/h2]

notes.title: BRXKEN INSIDE is available NOW! 🔥🔥🔥
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44738680/5ee7cb174dac1502ae37e077fe4ccd5c19cb7dfa.png[/img]

[h2]BRXKEN INSIDE is out now![/h2]

Shion's calm and measured life comes to an end when she meets Akiko. This encounter has the chance to change her life or plunge it further into the abyss of depression and hopelessness.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186690/BRXKEN_INSIDE

[h2]SPECIAL OFFER[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50365/BRXKEN_INSIDE_EXTRA/?snr=1_5_9__403

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Visual Novel, Psychological Thriller
[*] High-quality anime-style graphics
[*] Help the main character fight depression and the aftermath of an abusive relationship
[*] The narrative sometimes switches to another character to show a different side of the story
[*] An anxious dark atmosphere, which will be conveyed to the player through unusual sounds and visual effects
[*] Screen resolution 1440x1080 px (4:3 aspect ratio)
[*] Unexpected endings that depend on player choice
[/list]

Thank you for all the patience and support :3
